title: Natural History of Carotid Atherosclerosis
brief_summary: A prospective study of 700 patients with coronary artery disease will undergo non invasive evaluation of their carotid arteries by ultrasound and microwave radiometry. The patients will be followed up for 3 years and their outcome regarding the cardiovascular events (death, cardiac events, cerebrovascular events) will be recorded
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Consecutive patients with coronary artery disease admitted in our hospital

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with history of previous cerebrovascular event,
* History of vasculitis, intermittent inflammatory, infectious, or neoplastic conditions likely to be associated with an acute-phase response.
